purpose: Dry-run or separately execute the static directional S-QSTN RulePack v1.0 on a held-out diagnostic using discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2.

conditions.description: An anonymized participant background plus the discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2 prompt card and static directional RulePack v1.0 context.

sampling.unknown_status_policy: Unknown is not a dedicated stratum; it may appear only through the random_remaining slot. This diagnostic must not be treated as a final paper split.

labels: No, but ask me next time
Yes, but ask me next time

guardrails: The RulePack is static and directional only; no numerical weights or state updates are active.
Human label_id and label_text remain outside every QSTN prompt and inference plan.
Unknown context fields are not inferred and are recorded in rule_context_audit.csv.
Ordinary respondent denial is not treated as an agent violation.
This diagnostic does not establish general human-likeness, causal RulePack benefit, or longitudinal fidelity.
A final paper comparison must use a separately frozen evaluation split and pre-registered conditions.
